about.title: IDSHOPCASE.
about.subtitle: Crafting premium bespoke phone cases and personalized accessories since 2019.
about.storyP1: Founded in 2019 in Bogor, IDSHOPCASE began with a simple belief: a phone case is not just device protection, but an authentic medium of self-expression reflecting individuality.
about.storyP2: By pairing precision shockproof materials with high-definition UV printing technology, we are dedicated to delivering tactile comfort, long-lasting durability, and clean aesthetic appeal.
about.val1Desc: Each case is engineered to the exact contour of your device, delivering optimal drop protection without unnecessary bulk.
about.val2Desc: Utilizing Japanese industrial UV print technology to ensure colors remain vibrant, razor-sharp, and guaranteed fade-resistant.
about.val3Desc: Total creative freedom with your favorite artwork and custom photos through our interactive 3D studio.
about.ctaSubtitle: Launch our interactive custom studio to start designing your custom case today.
